description: smolagents CodeAgent run with one tool call and a final answer, traced by OpenInference.
notes: Only SmolagentsInstrumentor is enabled. The openai instrumentor would add a second llm span for each call, and the call would count twice; the page says not to enable it. The agent is a CodeAgent: the model answers in plain text with a <code> block, and the local Python executor runs it, so the request carries no tools. OpenAIServerModel is pointed at the mock. The tree is weather_agent.run [agent], with Step 1 [chain] over OpenAIModel.generate [llm] and SimpleTool [tool], then Step 2 [chain] over OpenAIModel.generate [llm] and FinalAnswerTool [tool]. The agent span carries the run's total token counts; cetra counts tokens on llm spans only, so nothing counts twice. The tool span is named after the tool class (SimpleTool, FinalAnswerTool); tool.name stays an attribute. Step start times land inside the Step spans' input.value repr, where volatile_attributes cannot reach them, so the program replaces smolagents' wall clock with a stepping counter; no timing value is a separate attribute, so the case lists no timing_attributes.
